lines.trans: Max, what are you doing here?
I am just standing and breathing air.
Are you following me again?
You have an important business meeting right now.
Max, tell the truth, are you jealous?
I am not jealous of you at all, Vika.
This is a meeting regarding the sale of the restaurant.
I am calm, go to your meeting.
Please drive my car home.
And you will go in his car?

words.gram: 3rd person masculine singular, accusative; г is said like в

lines.trans: Yes, we will go together to negotiations.

words.gram: particle in the set phrase да ну

lines.trans: It is time for me to go, bye, Max.

words.gloss: to me (мне некогда = I have no time)

lines.trans: Yes, of course, safe travels, Vika.
